title: Record Free API Classic callers in gen
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The Classic text and image Workers now forward CF-Connecting-IP and a validated Referer to gen, so Classic generations can be attributed to individual callers instead of appearing under the bridge keys with undefined IP and referrer fields. Referrer selection checks the referrer/referer query parameter first, then the text request body, then the Referer/Origin header; values outside printable ASCII or longer than 2,048 characters are omitted without failing the generation. Gen’s 10,000-requests-per-10-seconds edge limit consequently applies per caller rather than to Classic traffic as a whole, with no practical effect at current volume.
